## Incident Overview
Scenario Type: Deferred Review Nitpick

### Expected
Linking a story (3ee4, child of epic 588e) `depends_on` a bug (1b76, also a child of 588e) records the dependency at story level only. (Per the documented promotion model, parenting the bug under the epic keeps the link story-level.)

### Actual
The link was recorded on 3ee4 AND created `588e depends_on 1b76` (and `588e depends_on c9e9`) — the parent epic depending on its own child. Re-parenting the bugs under 588e first did NOT prevent the epic-level edge. Link altitude is therefore unpredictable / contradicts the promotion model. Low severity (redundant with the parent relationship) but confusing for next-batch/completion-verifier.

### Environment
* code_version: b68f1cfcdb09a2d7a44007262af3d83e6385e845
